<a id="fighter_update"></a>
### [`fighter_update`](../../../src/fighter_moves.asm#L6) `$2233`

*routine*

Updates fighter X for one frame: hit test, input, input fix-ups, move state, animation, end of animation, sprite priority. Called from the bout loop.

- **Called from:** [`bout_loop`](init_bout_loop.md#bout_loop) [`$15B7`](../../../src/init_bout_loop.asm#L215), [`bout_loop`](init_bout_loop.md#bout_loop) [`$15BE`](../../../src/init_bout_loop.asm#L218)

- **Reads:** [`SPSPCL`](../memory-map.md#SPSPCL), [`opponent_index`](../memory-map.md#opponent_index)
- **Writes:** [`front_fighter`](../memory-map.md#front_fighter)
- **Refers to:** [`move_attack_flags`](entry_and_tables.md#move_attack_flags)
